overview_description.description: Axle Energy provides software that connects residential energy assets, including electric vehicles, batteries, heat pumps, and solar systems, to electricity flexibility markets through a unified API. Its platform enables manufacturers, utilities, and energy providers to register devices, optimize energy consumption and storage, coordinate virtual power plants, and participate in grid flexibility programs. The company offers tools for smart charging, battery dispatch, demand response, customer onboarding, payment processing, and application integration through APIs and hosted components. It also supports energy market participation by scheduling flexible loads and distributed energy resources based on user preferences, electricity tariffs, and grid conditions.
